headline: Fire-crew's seated crew is back — and the store can no longer launder bot play
lede: The 30-hour freeze broke: Jon approved the fire-crew unfreeze and it landed on main. The nightly confirms the fix worked — and the only red left is a harness that had pinned the old bug as expected behavior.

notes.text: FIRE CREW #2178 shipped: the pillar loft gate no longer freezes the seated autopilot in the resume window — the watch seat actually drives the crew. Nightly watch keys 903/903 green with the fix.

Nightly went red again on the fixed tip — but the diagnosis says it's the harness, not the game: seed 1 seated now WINS 6/6 at tick 2179 (that IS the fix succeeding) while firecrewplay still demanded it lose at the clock. Full fix spec filed as #2194; two parked PLAICRAFT PRs wait behind it.

PLAICRAFT S1 (PR #2188): the store's relabel now stamps relabeledFrom/modelId/relabeledAt into the file, writes get their own SESSION_WRITE_KEY separate from the lanes' read key, and grading never counts a relabeled take toward 'Jon plays 3 sessions' — audit finding #2142 closed end to end, 96/96 relaycheck + two mutants proven.
Rule 5a landed with #2186: a red main now clears within 2 hours or gets quarantined with an open issue's name — this freeze is intended to be the last day-long one.
